caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design with a prominent yellow central field and a decorative border. The yellow center is filled with a repeating pattern of stylized floral motifs, primarily in red, blue, green, and white, with green leaves interspersed among the flowers. The border surrounding the central field is wider on two adjoining sides and is colored in shades of reddish-brown, pink, and yellow. This border features large, round, multidirectional flowers with white petals and blue centers, accompanied by green leaves and smaller flowers, as well as swirling yellow and pink foliage elements. Outside this, a narrow, wavy-edge border in red and yellow encases the floral section. The design is set on a plain, off-white or beige background with no additional objects or decorations beyond the textile pattern.
title: Kerchief
